skills.name: repo-summary
skills.description: Summarize a local source repository's structure, likely build and test commands, Git state, and review risks. Use for offline repository orientation or engineering handoff.

skills.name: skills-creator
skills.description: Create and validate portable Agent Skills with a dependency-free restricted authoring profile. Use when scaffolding a skill for mirrored or closed-network distribution.

skills.name: skills-installer
skills.description: List and securely install catalogued Agent Skills from local checkouts or Git remotes. Use for closed-network bootstrap, internal mirrors, or checksum-verified skill installation.
